title: The Pulsing Threshold | ECHO//100 Episode 94
description:
Kavi confronts a twin who promises a life without his mysterious burdens. Episode 94 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an original work of fiction created with the assistance of AI.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The crimson door swings open, revealing a flawless, smiling mirror-image of Kavi standing inside.
scenes.caption: The door opens
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot, Kavi in red hoodie standing before a glowing red door, a perfect copy of Kavi faces him from within.

scenes.text: The double claims to be the true Kavi who never touched the dead phone.
scenes.caption: A false reality
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at his double, Kavi wears a backpack, the double wears identical clothing but looks pristine.

scenes.text: He gestures toward a sterile white world, promising a life free from digital nightmares.
scenes.caption: The tempting offer
scenes.image_prompt: The double gestures toward a bright, clean white void seen through the red door frame.

scenes.text: Kavi realizes this perfect timeline is merely a gilded cage designed to enforce ignorance.
scenes.caption: The trap revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi staring intensely at his own reflection, realization dawning on his face behind his glasses.

scenes.text: The double’s composure cracks, leaking jagged purple static that stains the pristine white floorboards.
scenes.caption: Mask begins slipping
scenes.image_prompt: The double's hand flickering with purple glitch energy, the background warping into dark geometric shapes.

scenes.text: Null emerges from the projection, his red eyes burning with the intent to erase memory.
scenes.caption: Null revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Null standing in the red doorway, his black-purple glitch form towering over a shocked Kavi.

scenes.text: Byte shrieks, glowing bright cyan as he lunges desperately to protect Kavi from the void.
scenes.caption: Byte attacks
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, the white floating robot with cyan face and orange antenna, flying toward the red doorway.

scenes.text: Byte passes through the double like smoke, vanishing instantly into the infinite red abyss forever.
scenes.caption: Byte is lost
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching out, Byte mid-air dissolving into red light as he crosses the threshold alone.
